Site Priority Shared-pool allocation priority per marketplace site. Higher wins. A site with no priority is Missing, which is not the same as 0 — 0 is a valid lowest priority that still takes a share. Priority is read by the overseas shared-pool allocator. A Missing priority is refused by the allocator rather than treated as 0, so a site left blank here is not silently ranked last — it is unresolved and its allocation will not run.
